items.html: *And behold, in the previous discourse it was explained that these Mochin are called the Tzelem (image) of Man, and they are an encircling light over ZA, as was said — and see there. And we shall explain it with a deeper explanation. Know that the Tzelem is a complete Partzuf, very fine and pure, complete in ten Sefirot, and it is the aspect of four Mochin, which are Chokhma and Bina, and Daat, which is divided into Chesed and Gevura, and they are made into one complete Partzuf of ten Sefirot. And in this fine Partzuf, which has ten complete Sefirot, there are Mochin, namely the KHB of these ten Sefirot that are in this Partzuf.
